title: ShopKart Return Policy
content:
# ShopKart Return Policy

### 1. General Return Window
ShopKart offers a return window on eligible items delivered to customers in India:
- **Electronics & Mobiles:** 7 calendar days from delivery date.
- **Home & Kitchen Appliances:** 7 to 10 calendar days from delivery date.
- **Fashion & Footwear:** 15 calendar days from delivery date.
- **Large Furniture:** 10 calendar days from delivery date.

### 2. Return Eligibility & Conditions
To qualify for a full return:
- Products must be in original condition with all manufacturer tags, serial numbers, barcodes, warranty cards, and accessories intact.
- Items must not show signs of physical abuse, unauthorized modification, or water damage.
- Original packaging box and user manuals must be returned with the product.

### 3. Non-Returnable Items
For health, safety, and hygiene regulations, the following items are strictly non-returnable:
- Personal hygiene items, innerwear, socks, and lingerie.
- Oral care products (e.g. electric toothbrushes, replacement brush heads).
- Cosmetics, skincare serums, perfumes, and opened beauty formulations.
- Clearance or discontinued products explicitly flagged as 'Final Sale / Non-Returnable'.

### 4. Return Pickup & Inspection Process
- Once a return request is submitted in the ShopKart app/website, a logistics agent will be assigned for doorstep pickup within 24–48 business hours.
- A physical verification checklist will be performed by the field agent prior to accepting the package.
- If verified successfully, the return status moves to 'PICKED_UP' and the corresponding refund is automatically initiated.

title: ShopKart Refund Policy
content:
# ShopKart Refund Policy

### 1. Initiation Timelines
- **Pre-dispatch Order Cancellations:** Refund initiated immediately upon cancellation approval.
- **Doorstep Returns:** Refund initiated within 2 to 4 hours of the courier partner completing physical pickup.
- **Warehouse Returned Items:** Refund initiated within 24 hours of warehouse quality check clearance.

### 2. Refund Settlement Timelines by Payment Method
- **UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM):** 2 to 24 hours (usually instantaneous).
- **ShopKart Wallet / Instant Store Credit:** Instantaneous (0 to 15 minutes).
- **Credit Cards & Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay):** 3 to 5 business banking days.
- **Net Banking (All major Indian banks):** 3 to 7 business banking days.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders:** Processed via customer-provided UPI VPA or NEFT/IMPS bank account within 24 to 48 hours after return pickup.

### 3. Failed Refund Handling
If a refund fails due to an invalid UPI handle, closed bank account, or payment gateway timeout:
- SupportHub will notify the customer via SMS/Email to update their bank/UPI details in the Account section.
- The automated payment retry engine re-attempts the transaction within 24 hours of updated beneficiary details.

title: ShopKart Order Cancellation Policy
content:
# ShopKart Order Cancellation Policy

### 1. When Cancellation is Allowed
- Customers may cancel an order free of charge at any time while the order status remains **PLACED** or **CONFIRMED**.
- Self-service one-click cancellation is accessible directly from 'My Orders'.

### 2. When Cancellation is Blocked
- Once an order reaches **PACKED**, **SHIPPED**, or **IN_TRANSIT**, self-service online cancellation is automatically locked because warehouse logistics and courier manifests have been generated.
- In such cases, customers should refuse delivery at their doorstep when the courier agent arrives, or initiate a standard return post-delivery.

### 3. Merchant / Platform Cancellations
ShopKart reserves the right to cancel orders in rare situations such as:
- Item discovered to be damaged or out of stock during pre-dispatch warehouse quality inspection.
- Incomplete or unserviceable delivery address pincode.
- Flagged security alerts or suspected unauthorized payment transactions.

title: ShopKart Shipping and Delivery Policy
content:
# ShopKart Shipping and Delivery Policy

### 1. Standard Delivery Timelines
- **Metro & Tier-1 Cities (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune):** 2 to 4 calendar days.
- **Tier-2 & Tier-3 Cities:** 4 to 7 calendar days.
- **Special / Remote Regions (Northeast, J&K, Island territories):** 7 to 10 calendar days.

### 2. Logistics & Courier Partners
Orders are fulfilled via verified tier-1 logistics networks including Delhivery, BlueDart, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, and XpressBees. Live real-time tracking links are provided via SMS and order details.

### 3. Delivery Delays & Exceptions
Unforeseen delays may occur due to severe weather conditions (monsoons, floods), transit hub congestion, regional holidays, or transportation strikes. Customers receive automated tracking alerts whenever transit status updates to 'DELAYED'.

### 4. Delivery Address Changes
- Delivery addresses may be modified only while the order is in **PLACED** or **CONFIRMED** status.
- Once dispatched, address changes cannot be accommodated due to courier waybill locking.

title: ShopKart Warranty Policy
content:
# ShopKart Warranty Policy

### 1. Manufacturer Warranty
- All branded electronics, home appliances, IT peripherals, and audio equipment sold on ShopKart carry official manufacturer brand warranty (typically 1 to 3 years as specified on the product page).
- The official tax invoice downloaded from the ShopKart order page serves as the valid proof of purchase.

### 2. Scope of Warranty Coverage
- **Covered:** Inherent manufacturing defects, internal component failure, electrical circuit malfunction under normal usage.
- **Excluded:** Accidental damage, liquid spills, cracked screens, physical abuse, unauthorized third-party repairs, normal cosmetic wear and tear.

### 3. Onsite vs. Carry-in Service
- **Large Appliances & Televisions:** Supported by authorized brand technician onsite home visits.
- **Mobiles, Audio & Peripherals:** Supported via authorized brand service centers across India.

title: ShopKart Replacement Policy
content:
# ShopKart Replacement Policy

### 1. Replacement Eligibility
If a delivered product is damaged in transit, defective, or missing accessories, customers may opt for a free replacement instead of a refund within the designated return window.

### 2. Conditions for Replacement
- Replacement is subject to seller inventory availability.
- The replacement unit will be dispatched as soon as the original unit is picked up and verified by the logistics agent.
- If the required replacement SKU is out of stock, an automatic full refund will be processed.

title: ShopKart Exchange Policy
content:
# ShopKart Exchange Policy

### 1. Fashion & Footwear Size Exchanges
- Customers purchasing apparel or footwear may request a free size exchange (e.g. Size M to Size L, or UK 8 to UK 9) within 15 days of delivery.
- Size exchanges do not incur additional shipping or handling fees.

### 2. Exchange Fulfillment
- The courier agent delivers the new size and picks up the existing size during the same delivery attempt (Doorstep Exchange).

title: ShopKart Payment Policy
content:
# ShopKart Payment Policy

### 1. Accepted Payment Modes
- Unified Payments Interface (UPI) — Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, Amazon Pay, BHIM.
- Credit Cards & Debit Cards — Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, American Express, Diners Club.
- Net Banking — 50+ Indian commercial and public sector banks.
- Digital Wallets — ShopKart Wallet, Paytm, Mobikwik.
- Cash on Delivery (COD) — Available on orders up to ₹25,000 for serviceable pin codes.

### 2. Payment Security & Encryption
All online transactions are encrypted via 256-bit SSL protocols and processed through RBI-compliant PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment gateways. Two-Factor Authentication (OTP / UPI PIN) is mandatory.

### 3. Duplicate Deductions & Gateway Timeouts
If money is deducted from your bank account but your order is not confirmed due to a network interruption, the payment gateway auto-reverses the transaction within 24 to 48 banking hours.

title: ShopKart Account Management Policy
content:
# ShopKart Account Management Policy

### 1. Profile & Information Updates
Customers can manage saved shipping addresses, primary email IDs, and phone numbers via the Account Settings portal.

### 2. Account Security & Verification
- Changing login mobile numbers or registered email addresses requires OTP verification sent to both previous and new credentials.
- Multi-factor authentication is recommended for enhanced account safety.

### 3. Suspended & Locked Accounts
- Accounts with repeated fraudulent return claims or policy abuse may be temporarily suspended.
- In case of suspicious unauthorized logins from unfamiliar devices, accounts are placed in **LOCKED** status to safeguard customer payment data until identity is verified.

title: ShopKart Privacy & Security Policy
content:
# ShopKart Privacy & Security Policy

### 1. Customer Privacy Safeguards
ShopKart strictly protects user privacy. Support agents and automated AI assistants are prohibited from disclosing:
- Phone numbers, home addresses, or email addresses belonging to other customers.
- Order details, payment records, or shipment manifests belonging to unrelated accounts.
- One-Time Passwords (OTPs), CVVs, passwords, or banking credentials under any circumstances.

### 2. Reporting Unauthorized Access
If you detect unfamiliar order placements, unexpected address changes, or suspect account compromise, contact ShopKart Trust & Safety immediately to freeze account activity and initiate audit logs.
